tab10.info: Tableau's classic "Tableau 10" palette, designed by Maureen Stone for Tableau 1.5. Also d3's `category10` and matplotlib's `tab10` (its default color cycle).

tab10_colorblind.info: Tableau's "Color Blind 10" palette, designed to be distinguishable with color vision deficiencies. Also matplotlib's `tableau-colorblind10` style.

tab10_new.info: The "Tableau 10" palette as redesigned for Tableau 10 (2016) by Maureen Stone and Cristy Miller. Also d3's `schemeTableau10`.

tab20.info: Tableau's classic "Tableau 20" palette: light and dark pairs of the Tableau 10 hues. Also d3's `category20` and matplotlib's `tab20`.

info: Categorical palettes from Tableau. The classic palettes date from Tableau 1.5 (2004); "tab10_new" is the current "Tableau 10", redesigned for Tableau 10 (2016): https://www.tableau.com/blog/colors-upgrade-tableau-10-56782
